verdict.rationale: Luma ships agentic workflows (Luma Agents, Skills), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any MCP client support or a way to connect external MCP servers. The API, SDK, llms.txt and agent-workflow evidence is adjacent and does not show the product consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
